name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme as the default with a persistent one-click toggle to light mode. Dark themes reduce eye strain in low light and highlight data density, matching Manus’s competitive analysis and Graphify’s central interactive graph. The trade-off is that some users may prefer light mode for readability in bright environments, but the toggle keeps the choice visible and reversible.
